parts:
An MCP server is more than an API wrapper.

Can an AI agent find a tool, handle errors, and finish real tasks?

Anthropic's mcp-builder recommends 10 verifiable eval questions.

Test outcomes, not endpoints:
https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/skills/mcp-builder
